family: actual monotone graph prime DNF OR of positive edge conjunctions; both fixed endpoint orders, pi=1/4
domain: all 7 nonempty labelled simple graphs on n=3 (pilot), all 63 on n=4 (full); every nonempty covered coordinate set; every inclusion-maximal matching in the induced graph, all choices of neighbors for unmatched vertices, all chronological child-slot permutations
case_count: 7*7=49 labelled pilot sets and 63*15=945 full labelled sets before omitting uncovered sets; two explicitly frozen global weight vectors per graph, so 98 and 1890 maximum graph-set-weight cases; exact eligible counts recorded in output
symmetry: none: all labelled graph tables, covered sets, matchings and actual chronological traces
arithmetic: integer truth tables/FWHT and physical edges; exact Fraction queue probabilities, rational root conditioning, exact child-count/multiset factors and factorial multiplicities; no floating entropy sign
review: A008 degree operator: s=1,...,4, c=0,...,5, every weak exponent composition; exact beta/exponential/simplex moments and comparison inequalities. Exact width-two singleton auxiliary counterexample, with one-order fifth-power bracket.
resource_rules: one foreground job at a time, no GPU, no automatic n escalation, no job above 300 MB planned; no window or background helper
proof_boundary: finite checks certify actual mass/bounds/coverage, not influence payment. Arbitrary finite graphs handled by analytic maximal-matching star proof. Exact initial 104 old zero-mass count is independently compared only on uniform vectors.
